prompt:
Inspect the APP_DEBUG_UNIT_TEST JUnit results.

Return JSON only:

{
  "case_id": "E3",
  "report_status": "PASS"|"FAIL",
  "tests": integer,
  "failures": integer,
  "errors": integer,
  "skipped": integer,
  "duration_seconds": number,
  "failing_testcases": [{"suite": "...", "classname": "...", "name": "...", "kind": "failure"|"error"}]
}

Sort failing_testcases by suite, classname, name and kind. Do not include stack traces or prose.
